selection_rule: Publisher CSV order: first two distinct sessions for SF7/BW125k/CR1 and SF10/BW250k/CR1, excluding development session 25_01_17-13_40; first row in each selected session/configuration, no SNR or payload selection.

limitations: Centered single-channel search only; fractional CFO from preamble repetition, no integer CFO or RF center estimation.
BW 125/250/500 kHz, SF7–SF12, both chirp directions; six stable FFT peaks and either individual concentration or a coherent six-chirp average required.
Other CSS waveforms can match preamble evidence. Header checksum and supported payload CRC are checked separately; all other stages remain candidates. Payload: explicit CR4/5–4/8, SF7–SF10 only.
CRC-valid payloads can use a single sync-word-inferred boundary with an unconfirmed quarter chirp; see quarter_chirp_validated and boundary_method in each frame.
At most eight one-second input windows selected from prefix, bounded energy profiling and distributed probes; no guarantee of complete file coverage.
At most 256 symbols per BW/SF/window; coverage is reported separately per configuration. Unsearched periods can contain signals.
Eight-phase local timing refinement requires SF7-10 and >=2 samples/chip; clock drift is not tracked. Chip indices remain relative to their analysis window.

carrier_tracking.scope: Preamble repetition only; fractional carrier offset modulo BW/2**SF, not RF center or integer CFO

timing_tracking.scope: Preamble-only sample phase selection; no header, payload, CRC or reference bytes used

synchronization.scope: Two opposite-direction chirps only; sync word, quarter chirp, exact boundary and payload not validated

sync_word.scope: Conventional two-nibble sync-word hypothesis only; no network identity, quarter-chirp, header, CRC or payload validation

data_symbols.scope: Raw relative CSS bins only; timing remains a hypothesis. No Gray mapping, deinterleaving, error correction, whitening, header, CRC or payload bytes decoded

explicit_header.scope: Explicit-header hypothesis only; no payload CRC, bytes or emitter identity validated
explicit_header.validation: 5-bit header checksum only; payload is not decoded or validated

payload.scope: LoRa PHY bytes only; no LoRaWAN identity, authentication or decryption
payload.validation: Header 5-bit checksum and LoRa payload CRC16 passed; not emitter authenticity

candidates.validation_scope: Bounded LoRa PHY trial; only explicit header checks and supported payload CRC results are validated. No LoRaWAN identity or authentication.

First two distinct sessions per available supported SF/BW/CR configuration, excluding the development session; selected before decoding.
Whole member blind detection; no verified RF center; source member hashes verified, full archive hash not verified.
Subsequent decoder changes invalidate the first-pass label; preserve this report as historical evidence.
Decode misses remain outcomes; transport, integrity or size errors fail the run without selecting replacements.
